text: Testing is an essential part of software development. Developers write unit tests to check small pieces of code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests then examine how different parts of a system work together. Many teams also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Although testing takes time, it gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything, and they can release new features more safely.
